! Game text
| '''0 side — Local Uprising'''<br />''Deploy Hoth system and [Virtual Block 6] [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V) (Virtual Block 6){{!}}Main Power Generators]]. May deploy [[Echo Base Garrison]] and/or [[Maneuvering Flaps (V) (Virtual Block 2){{!}}Maneuvering Flaps]].'' '''For''' remainder of game, you may not deploy [[Hoth Sentry]] or non-Hoth locations (except [[Rendezvous Point]]). [[T-47 Battle Formation]] is {{Errata hl|1=an Out Of Play Interrupt and}} [Immune to Sense]. '''While''' this side up, during your deploy phase, may ▼ an exterior Hoth site or a non-unique Rebel to Hoth. '''Flip''' this card during your move phase if you control three exterior Hoth sites with T-47s and/or non-unique Rebels. '''Place''' out of play if Main Power Generators 'blown away.'<br />'''7 side — Liberation'''<br />'''While''' this side up, Wedge may not cancel battle destiny draws on Hoth. During your control phase: opponent loses 1 Force for each battleground marker site you control with both a T-47 and a Rebel, and you may use two Force to ▲ any one card. Whenever you must lose Force (except from your card, battle damage, or a Force drain at a battleground), reduce the loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of Hoth locations you occupy. '''Flip''' this card if you do not control 2 exterior Hoth sites. '''Place''' out of play if Main Power Generators 'blown away.' || '''0 side — Local Uprising'''<br />''Deploy Hoth system and [Virtual Block 6] [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V) (Virtual Block 6){{!}}Main Power Generators]]. May deploy [[Echo Base Garrison]] and/or [[Maneuvering Flaps (V) (Virtual Block 2){{!}}Maneuvering Flaps]].'' '''For''' remainder of game, you may not deploy [[Hoth Sentry]] or non-Hoth locations (except [[Rendezvous Point]]). [[T-47 Battle Formation]] {{Errata hl|1=may only be played once per game and}} is [Immune to Sense]. '''While''' this side up, during your deploy phase, may ▼ an exterior Hoth site or a non-unique Rebel to Hoth. '''Flip''' this card during your move phase if you control three exterior Hoth sites with T-47s and/or non-unique Rebels. '''Place''' out of play if Main Power Generators 'blown away.'<br />'''7 side — Liberation'''<br />'''While''' this side up, Wedge may not cancel battle destiny draws on Hoth. During your control phase: opponent loses 1 Force for each battleground marker site you control with both a T-47 and a Rebel, and you may use two Force to ▲ any one card. Whenever you must lose Force (except from your card, battle damage, or a Force drain at a battleground), reduce the loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of Hoth locations you occupy. '''Flip''' this card if you do not control 2 exterior Hoth sites. '''Place''' out of play if Main Power Generators 'blown away.'
